These thematic similarities are insufficient to establish a material drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Our librarians serve the precious liberties of our nation: freedom of inquiry, freedom of the spoken and the written word, freedom of exchange of ideas.","parent_excerpt":"The Government's films, publications, libraries, overseas information centers, and exchange of persons activities have given the world a clearer understanding of this country's progress and ideals.","explanation":"C12 mentions libraries as part of an information program, but does not reproduce the child's intellectual-freedom formulation or its anti-censorship reasoning."},{"child_excerpt":"freedom cannot be served by the devices of the tyrant","parent_excerpt":"the freedom of reading and listening to what they choose, the right of free speech","explanation":"C15 contains a related enumeration of freedoms, but the phrasing and function are generic and embedded in a national-emergency proclamation."},{"child_excerpt":"full, unfettered knowledge of its own heritage, of freedom's enemies","parent_excerpt":"the cause of truth and freedom will prevail","explanation":"C25 shares broad Cold War language about truth, freedom, and communist repression, without a concrete drafting structure or distinctive verbal correspondence."}]}
